confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Bologna price levels for July 2026. No live booking pages or current listings were inspected. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the most reliable; accommodation is less certain and may run higher during trade-fair periods. Cocktail and wine are bounded using the local beer-to-drink relationship rather than direct price knowledge. FX caveat: the only RBA USD/AUD observation I could retrieve is 0.7088 dated 2026-03-20, from a cached rba.gov.au page. Several searches returned conflicting, unverified later figures, so I did not use them. This rate is likely stale for an October 2026 generation date and should be refreshed from the RBA F11 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on comparable mid-sized northern Italian cities with strong tourism and university demand, such as Florence, Parma and Verona, adjusted for Bologna's restaurant prices and seasonal July hotel demand.
